Deputy Chief Engineer vs Bijalbhai Deganbhai on 4 April, 2025

 In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad
 R/Misc. Civil Application (For Recall) No. 752 of 2025

entities.text: High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In R/First Appeal No. 2728 of 2024
 ==========================================================
 Deputy Chief Engineer
 Versus
 Bijalbhai Deganbhai & Ors.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 Ms Archana U Amin(2462) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Mr. Jay Mehta, Agp for the Opponent(s) No. 2,3
 ==========================================================
 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep N. Bhatt
 Date : 04/04/2025
 Oral Order

1. Heard Ms. Archana Amin, learned advocate for the applicant and Mr. Jay Mehta, learned AGP for the respondents - State.
2. Ms. Archana Amin, learned advocate for the applicant has submitted that due to some bonafide mistake and misunderstanding on the part of her colleague at the relevant point of time, she has wrongly mentioned before the Court on 09.10.2024 that the amount of compensation as per the award has been deposited before the concerned Court and, therefore, the Court has passed the order on 09.10.2024 in First NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/752/2025 ORDER DATED: 04/04/2025 undefined Appeal No.2728 of 2024 and connect matter, which is on the basis of erroneous submission made by her colleague and she has further submitted that it is a bonefide mistake, which has been committed due to some miscommunication.
She has further submitted that the Court has inherent power under under Section 151 of the CPC to recall and rectify an order where a factual error has influenced the judicial determination.

She has further submitted that due to absence of order granting stay on the impugned judgment and direction to deposit the awarded amount, the Deputy Chief Engineer vs Bijalbhai Deganbhai on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40337871/
1 applicant has been unable to comply with any such order requiring the deposit.
3. The submission made at the bar are as such not required to be scrutinized further in detail as Ms.
Archana Amin, learned advocate for the applicant has fairly submitted that there is bonafide mistake on the part of her colleague whiling mentioning regarding deposit of amount and the Court has passed the order on such erroneous submission made at the bar.

sentences.text: In the given case, the Court is taking strict view of such submission where the Court is of the opinion that such submission is made with a view to take undue NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/752/2025 ORDER DATED: 04/04/2025 undefined advantage or wrongful gain.

In the present case, prima facie, it seems that the applicant is the Deputy Chief Engineer, Western Railways, Rajkot and for the mistake which is committed by the counsel, the litigant should not suffer and, therefore, the Court is restraint to impose any cost for such erroneous submission made at the relevant point of time.
With a further observation that the counsel should be more careful in future to make such submissions.

4. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances and considering the fact that the order is passed pursuant to the compensation paid under the Land Acquisition Act, which is a beneficial provision under the law and the applicant is bound to pay the additional interest for the period from the date of the order, while depositing the amount when the civil application is again considered by the concerned Court.
The interest of litigant/claimant is also protected to that extent.

Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that the present applicant has made out case in peculiar facts and circumstances of the case for recalling of the order dated 09.10.2024 passed in Civil Application No.1 of 2024 NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/752/2025 ORDER DATED: 04/04/2025 undefined in First Appeal No.2728 of 2024.
5.
Accordingly, the order dated 09.10.2024 passed by this Court in Civil Application No.1 of 2024 in First Appeal No.2728 of 2024 is recalled.
The Registry to restore the same to its original file before the appropriate Court for further consideration.
With above observation, the present application is disposed of.
